CNGA radius-1 neighborhood is the only evidence-backed discovery surface (plateau-vs-single-point test plus G41/position-54 swap hypotheses); deterministic Hamming-1 probes around top measured parents, top-6 ranks, radius held at 1 per local-search specialist; no duplicate sequences across actions.
